reasons.claim: Two eligible species (VU, forest-associated, felling-relevant, site-bound) recorded within 250 m: Alectoria sarmentosa (VU, lichen, 13 records, nearest 37 m, 2025) and Goodyera repens (VU, vascular plant, nearest 142 m, 2025).
Three site-bound forest NT species also recorded within 250 m (Chaenotheca subroscida, Phellinidium ferrugineofuscum, Fomitopsis rosea), with felling-related threat factors.
No completed felling overlaps the polygon (0%); status is notified, not yet felled.
Effort is adequate (266 records, county median 66, 90th percentile); records have 10 m uncertainty, small relative to the 60 m equivalent radius.

uncertainties: Records are from only 2 observation days within 250 m, so they may reflect a single survey effort.
No records fall inside the polygon; nearest eligible record is 37 m from the edge.
not_established: Whether any listed species occupies the 1.11 ha polygon itself.
Absence of records inside the polygon does not mean absence of species.
Habitat quality and stand condition were not assessed.
next_action: Refer for human ecological review, including a field check for lichens, fungi and plants in and adjacent to the polygon before felling can begin.
